clues: This town sits on a flat plain in the middle of Spain, a short way south west of the capital. A small stream runs through its streets.
Far from the sea, this town swings more than coast towns do. Winters bring frost and cold, while summers are hot and dry each year.
This town was founded in 1280, when a king ruled the land. It later came under the rule of the capital town in 1345.
One of Spain's first asylums opened here in 1851, to care for folk with ill minds. It was a new kind of care for its time.
Old guard barracks here now form part of a large college. A famed builder drew up the plans for them long ago, in the 1700s.
